topic: Official Quint documentation for model-based testing, run/test traces, reproducible seeds, invariant checking, and replay into implementations

sources.title: Quint Cheat Sheet
sources.method: Two official-domain web searches; opened one official PDF page result. The Quint CLI documentation URL was attempted but inaccessible, so no claims are drawn from it.
sources.authority: First-party Quint language reference maintained by an author identified in the document; concise cheat sheet rather than full CLI or testing manual.
sources.locator: PDF page 2 (zero-based P1): lines 193-194 (`assert`), 213-240 (runs and test1).
claims: The sheet describes init.then(step) as executing init and then step when init succeeds.
The sheet describes n.reps(i => step) as executing the step n times and exposing the iteration number i.
The test1 example chains activate("a") and activate("b"), then asserts that both are in active.
not_documented_on_opened_page: generated trace export or replay format
